```{r}
# Function to find and omit outliers
find_and_omit_outliers <- function(data) {
  q1 <- quantile(data$chng, 0.25)
  q3 <- quantile(data$chng, 0.75)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  lower_bound <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  upper_bound <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  outliers <- data$chng[data$chng < lower_bound | data$chng > upper_bound]
  data_without_outliers <- data[data$chng >= lower_bound & data$chng <= upper_bound, ]
  return(data_without_outliers)
}
```

Seward
```{r}
# Find and omit outliers for each year
outliers_dataframes <- lapply(split(gwl_seward, gwl_seward$year), function(data) {
  find_and_omit_outliers(data)
})

# Combine results into a single table
outliers_combined <- do.call(rbind, outliers_dataframes)

# Print the combined table of outliers
#print(outliers_combined)

p1 <- ggplot(outliers_combined, aes(x= year, y= chng))+
  geom_boxplot()
p1 + labs(title= "Seward", x = "Year", y = "Change in water level (ft)")

# converting year to a factor for grouping
outliers_combined$year <- as.factor(outliers_combined$year)

#Mean
outliers_combined_SW <-outliers_combined %>%
  group_by(COUNTY_NAME, year) %>%
  summarise(chng = mean(chng))
```

WATER USE DATA
```{r}
use <- use[ ,c("PDIV_ID", "county_abrev", "COUNTY_COD", "AF_USED_2010", "ACRES_2010", "AF_USED_2011", "ACRES_2011", "AF_USED_2012", "ACRES_2012", "AF_USED_2013","ACRES_2013","AF_USED_2014", "ACRES_2014", "AF_USED_2015", "ACRES_2015", "AF_USED_2016","ACRES_2016", "AF_USED_2017", "ACRES_2017",
               "AF_USED_2018","ACRES_2018", "AF_USED_2019", "ACRES_2019", "AF_USED_2020", "ACRES_2020", "AF_USED_2021", "ACRES_2021", "AF_USED_2022", "ACRES_2022", "AF_USED_2023", "ACRES_2023")]

#Identifying Outliers in water use data
#To avoid the influence of outliers, wells are excluded that reported irrigation on
#less than 40 acres (Obembe et al 2023)
```


```{r}
#pivot the data frame into a long format
use_long <-
  use %>% pivot_longer(cols=c("AF_USED_2010", "ACRES_2010", "AF_USED_2011", "ACRES_2011", "AF_USED_2012", "ACRES_2012", "AF_USED_2013","ACRES_2013","AF_USED_2014", "ACRES_2014", "AF_USED_2015", "ACRES_2015", "AF_USED_2016","ACRES_2016", "AF_USED_2017", "ACRES_2017",
               "AF_USED_2018","ACRES_2018", "AF_USED_2019", "ACRES_2019", "AF_USED_2020", "ACRES_2020", "AF_USED_2021", "ACRES_2021", "AF_USED_2022", "ACRES_2022", "AF_USED_2023", "ACRES_2023"),
                    names_to='variable',
                    values_to='points') %>% 
  mutate(year = str_sub(variable, start = -4, end = -1),
         variable_noyr = str_sub(variable, start = 1, end = -6)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-variable) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("county_abrev", "COUNTY_COD", "year", "PDIV_ID"),
              names_from = "variable_noyr", values_from = "points") %>% 
  mutate(irrigation_ft = AF_USED/ACRES,
         irrigation_mm = irrigation_ft*12*25.4) %>%
  subset(ACRES > 0)
```

# Remove rows with NA values in columns A, B, and C

use_long <- use_long[complete.cases(use_long[, c("irrigation_ft", "irrigation_mm")]), ]
```

# Mean
outliers_combined_use <- use_long %>%
  group_by(county_abrev, year) %>%
  summarize(across(c(ACRES, irrigation_mm), list(mean = mean, sd = sd)))
```

# change in water level vs water use

```{r}
x_expression <- expression(Annual~mean~water~use~(10^6~ m^3))
SW<- ggscatter(all_seward, x= "use_m", y= "chng_m", add = "reg.line",
               conf.int = TRUE, size=4,
               #label = "year", repel = TRUE,
               cor.coeff.args = list(method = "pearson", label.x = 3, label.sep = "\n"))+
  stat_cor(label.x = 0.45, label.y = -0.02, size=6.5, #change the y value for rescaling
           aes(label=paste(..rr.label.., ..p.label.., sep = "~`,`~")))+
  stat_regline_equation(label.x = 0.45, label.y = -0.12, size= 6.5)+
  ggtitle("Seward")+labs(x=x_expression,
                             y="Annual mean change in water level (m)")+
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22), # Increase x-axis label font size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22), # Increase y-axis label font size
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 22),  # Increase x-axis tick labels font size
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 22),  # Increase y-axis tick labels font size
    #legend.text = element_text(size = 12),  # Increase legend text font size (if applicable)
    plot.title = element_text(size = 25)    # Increase plot title font size
  )

library(ggrepel)

SW<- SW+ geom_text_repel(aes(label = year), size = 7)  # Adjust size for year labels
SW

  #SW1 <- SW +
   #geom_text_repel(aes(label=year), size=3.3)
  #SW1
```

```{r}
model <- lm(all_barton$chng_m ~ all_barton$use_m)
model
# Get residuals
residuals <- model$residuals

# Calculate RSS (Residual Sum of Squares (RSS))
RSS <- sum(residuals^2)
print(RSS)

# Degrees of freedom
df <- model$df.residual

# Calculate MSE, df is n−p, where n is the number of observations, and p is the number of parameters (including the intercept)
MSE <- RSS / df
print(MSE)

# Calculate Total Sum of Squares (TSS)
TSS <- sum((all_barton$chng_m - mean(all_barton$chng_m))^2)

# Calculate R-squared
R_squared <- 1 - (RSS / TSS)
print(R_squared)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
